records.name: Lovelysheet
records.tagline: Productivity · Spreadsheets · No-Code · Data Management
records.description: Lovelysheet is a powerful online spreadsheet data cleaning and transformation tool. Clean, format, and automate Excel, CSV, or Google Sheets data visually using nodes with zero formulas required.

records.name: Hum - Voice Conversations
records.tagline: Clubhouse, but 1:1. Free voice networking, interest based.
records.description: A voice-first social app, like Clubhouse. But one-on-one, and it speaks from 6PM to midnight every evening - the Golden hour. Hum lets you connect with with people who share your interests. No photos, no swiping, no text. Every evening. 6PM - 12 AM -> Golden Hours The app doesn't allow calls outside Golden Hours. After every call you both decide privately to keep each other, else you depart once the call disconnect. If connected, you have earned a voice who shares your interest to connect later.

records.name: regards.design
records.tagline: Curated website design inspiration, searchable by aesthetics
records.description: Hand-picked websites, cut into sections, searchable by how they look. Ask for “a footer with a giant wordmark” or “sections like stripe.com” and get the real ones, linked to the live site. Connect Claude, Cursor or Codex and your agent designs from them too.

records.name: LucidLaw — Your law. Made easy.
records.tagline: Plain-language legal guidance for everyday Australians
records.description: LucidLaw gives everyday Australians plain-language legal guidance on tenancy, employment, consumer rights, and family law. Know your rights. Join the waitlist.

records.name: vemmsunj
records.tagline: Interactive sky-watching map for satellites & dark skies.
records.description: VEMMSUNJ is an open-source sky-watching map for stargazers and satellite spotters. Key features: • Live satellite ground tracks & pass predictions • Dark-sky spots and observatory discovery • Red-light mode to protect your night vision • Personal sighting logs to track observations Free, MIT-licensed, and powered by NASA JPL, CelesTrak, and NOAA data. Built for clear nights and curious minds.

records.name: PrvtChat
records.tagline: Private conversations. Temporary by design.
records.description: PRVTCHAT is a simple, privacy-focused chat experience that lets you create a private room, share a link, and start chatting. Designed for temporary conversations, with room expiry options and a clean, minimal interface.

records.name: Squeeze: Photo Video Compress
records.tagline: Shrink photos and videos to a target size, fully offline
records.description: Squeeze compresses photos and videos on your Android phone so they fit email limits, upload forms and chat apps. Pick Balanced, Smaller, or set an exact target size in KB or MB. It handles JPEG, PNG, WebP and MP4, batches up to 20 files, and lets you compare before and after. Everything runs offline: nothing is uploaded and your originals are never replaced. All features are free, supported by a small banner ad, with no subscription.

records.name: SBOX Camera
records.tagline: Live filters and photo editing for your everyday moments
records.description: SBOX Camera brings live filters, photo and video capture, photo editing, and a capture gallery into one camera app. Preview a different look for everyday scenes, import a photo to edit, then view or save your captures. Available on Android, iOS and the web. Features and permissions vary by platform, so the same tools are not available everywhere.

records.name: Utilvance Percentage Calculator
records.tagline: Free percentage calculator with steps and no sign-up
records.description: Utilvance Percentage Calculator gives you exact percentage answers in seconds. Find X% of a number, work out what percent one number is of another, add or subtract a percentage, calculate increase or decrease, or reverse a percentage. Each result comes with a plain sentence so you can check your inputs. It is free, runs in your browser, and needs no sign-up. It is one of 71+ free tools on Utilvance. visit now Utilvance.com

records.name: SAGE by Sharpe Group
records.tagline: AI governance for real-world real estate operations
records.description: Sharpe Group helps multifamily real estate organizations adopt AI with clear decision authority, human oversight, and accountability. Its practical governance framework helps teams define where AI can be used, when human intervention is required, and how decisions are documented and monitored.

records.name: Zuzu Made
records.tagline: Create personalized digital surprises for every occasion
records.description: 💖 Make every moment special with ZUZU MADE! 🎁 Create personalized birthday 🎂, love 💕 and anniversary 💍 surprises with photos, heartfelt messages & beautiful memories. ✨

records.name: Box of Cards
records.tagline: Cards Against Humanity online alternative, free in browser
records.description: Box of Cards is a free online multiplayer party card game where you build ridiculous fill‑in‑the‑blank sentences by shaping your cards so they snap perfectly into the gaps. Play in your browser with friends, combine different decks, and turn every round into a new inside joke.

records.name: Mamet
records.tagline: Write screenplays in a space made for filmmakers.
records.description: Mamet is a focused screenwriting workspace for filmmakers. Write and revise in screenplay format, keep project materials alongside your script, and export to Fountain, Final Draft (FDX), TXT, or a Mamet backup. Mamet keeps the focus on writing, with no AI-generated screenplay text. We’re opening a free private alpha and would love your feedback.

records.name: Your Password Generator
records.tagline: Generated on your device. Verify it yourself.
records.description: Free strong password generator: random, secure passwords 8-64 characters long, or 10,000 at once. Generated in your browser, never sent or stored.

records.name: RankIndia
records.tagline: India's live leaderboard. List from ₹1, outbid to be #1.
records.description: RankIndia is a public leaderboard for Indian startups, apps, D2C brands, creators, college projects and local businesses. One rule: the highest total bid is #1. List for ₹1 (about 1 cent). Bid anything via UPI or card. Bids add up through the month, anyone can boost anyone, and every board resets on the 1st. Each listing also ranks on its state and category board, so a ₹50 bid can make you #1 in Bihar or in College Projects. Winners stay in the Hall of Fame forever.

records.name: DepthLoop Studio
records.tagline: Turn your photos into cinematic 3D videos, now with AI
records.description: DepthLoop Studio turns your photos into cinematic 3D motion videos in the browser, with no install and no 3D skills. Pick from 70+ motion styles and 60+ templates, add text, counters and music, and export an MP4. New: describe your video and AI designs every scene (copy, motion, transitions, music), or describe a motion and AI builds a brand-new motion style from your sentence. Multi-scene videos, a free CC0 music library, and it works on web and phone. Free to start.

records.name: Paraphrase
records.tagline: Edit your voice like text.
records.description: Eliminates tedious audio and video editing by letting users edit recordings directly through their transcript. AI automatically removes filler words, false starts, repetition and unnecessary sections, dramatically reducing the time spent cleaning up recordings manually.

records.name: MELRA
records.tagline: Local MCP runtime with policy, approvals & recovery
records.description: An agent can finish a write even when its response gets lost. Retrying may duplicate the change. MELRA is an open-source local runtime for MCP and CLI tools. It checks policy and scoped approvals before actions, verifies declared outcomes, and keeps a redacted record. An interrupted HTTP write with an unclear result is parked for reconciliation instead of replayed. Alpha software; requires Node.js 22.13+.

records.name: Wymagine
records.tagline: Image Generator Agent - Wymagine AI
records.description: Create, edit, and refine images with Wymagine’s free AI image generator agent. Start with a prompt or reference image, then use follow-up instructions to improve the result.

records.name: WalkFind
records.tagline: Turn city walks into exciting audio treasure hunts
records.description: WalkFind turns your city walks into an interactive audio treasure hunt. Discover 200+ hidden spots, secret stories, and historical pubs in London and Stockholm without fixed routes. Collect points, follow real-time distance guides, and explore at your own pace. Available in English, Swedish, German, and Spanish with free-to-explore city maps.

records.name: Vignette - Shared Camera
records.tagline: One event. Everyone's photos
records.description: Remember disposable cameras? Vignette brings that experience back, but for everyone at your event! Create a shared camera, invite friends with a QR code or link, and start snapping. The twist? Nobody can see the photos until the event ends. No previews, no retakes, just capturing moments as they happen. Once it’s over, the entire gallery unlocks for everyone at once. Perfect for parties, weddings, trips, and nights out. Available on iOS, with web support for Android guests!

records.name: Reflex-Shield
records.tagline: Duress and hijack defense (banks, crypto platforms & others)
records.description: REFLEX Shield: duress and hijack decision engine and demo console. Built by Dolapo Oyatomi, Reflex Forge.

records.name: QRX
records.tagline: Art QR codes that always scan, from a prompt and a link

records.name: claude-term

records.description: A macOS terminal built for Claude Code. Track tokens per session (input, output, cache), see which skills eat your context, and watch your 5-hour and weekly limits live. Every session in one sidebar. Local, no telemetry, open source.

records.name: PrintCal.co

records.description: PrintCal.co helps 3D printing businesses and sign makers calculate prices from material, machine time, energy, failures and margin. Import supported 3MF or G-code files, save projects and generate PDF proposals. Manage customers and material inventory, and create channel letters and illuminated signs in the browser. Free calculators and a limited free account are available. Production queue features are in beta.

records.name: Chati.AI

More than a chatbot, it can control your PC, browse the web, send emails, use tools and skills, automate tasks and remember conversations. It supports local and cloud LLMs, multiple AI providers and automatic account switching. No technical skills needed: it detects your hardware, downloads suitable AI models and configures everything for you

records.name: Bike2Game

records.description: Bike2Game turns an exercise bike into a Windows game controller using a compatible Bluetooth Low Energy cadence sensor. Pedal to send input to controller-compatible PC games, move in VRChat through OSC, or trigger W-key movement in keyboard-based games. It reads crank cadence live and offers three output modes in one lightweight app. Try it free for 7 days, then unlock it with a one-time license. Designed for Windows 10 and 11; requires a compatible cadence sensor and Bluetooth LE adapter.

records.name: imagetolatex
records.tagline: Convert math screenshots to LaTeX and Word equations
records.description: imagetolatex turns screenshots, photos and handwritten math into LaTeX you can copy, check against a live preview and paste into Overleaf, Markdown or Word as an editable equation. Printed formulas are recognized for free each day; handwriting, multi-formula pages and whole PDF or Word documents convert to LaTeX, Word, Markdown or Excel with credits. It also includes a free LaTeX equation editor, a LaTeX table generator and a reference of common LaTeX symbols.

records.name: Connected Intelligence
records.tagline: Where ordinary software stops being enough.
records.description: Where ordinary software stops being enough, Connected Intel builds bespoke operational software, data platforms, and decision systems for complex, regulated organisations. We eliminate the hidden cost of fragmented spreadsheets, disconnected data, and manual reconciliation across energy, engineering, finance, and manufacturing. By turning specialist judgement into traceable, defensible automation, we protect your margins and scale your operations without increasing administrative headcount.

records.name: cp-design-system
records.tagline: Animated UI components for React and React Native
records.description: cp-design-system is an open-source UI kit for React and React Native. Write a screen once and it renders natively on the web, iOS, Android and Expo with the same API. 41 accessible components, from buttons and forms to toasts, modals, bottom sheets and carousels, built on Atlassian’s design tokens. Pass one brand color to re-theme everything in light and dark mode. Smooth springs and gestures run on the UI thread, and respect reduced motion. TypeScript, MIT, free on npm.

By Haku.

Discover early calls across 24 asset categories, monitor entry prices, take-profit and stop-loss levels, and analyze trader performance, win rates, and ROI. Turn social trading calls into measurable insights and make more informed decisions using recorded data. Before you follow the call, check the record

Try it with no keys: pipx install quorus-ai && quorus demo. Open source, MIT.

records.name: Watt

Voice control (say "Call Marie" and it calls), messages shown large and read aloud, cards you can rearrange. Designed so an older person can use it alone, without depending on a relative. Available in 35 languages. Free for 15 days with no bank card, then a one-time €9.90 for up to 3 phones. No subscription.

records.name: Everyday
records.tagline: "Locket" app for running
records.description: Everyday makes running feel less lonely. Track your runs, save your milestones, and share progress with your crew.

Processing runs in the browser, often in Web Workers, so documents and pasted text are not uploaded to our servers for those tools.

Photo processing stays in your browser. Edit one photo for free; batch processing is available with a one-time Pro purchase.

records.name: Kitten

records.description: Client-side AST dependency mapping, topological blast-radius, and deep codebase telemetry.

Slice is source-available and built for people who care about how their software looks and feels.

records.name: Meenuu

records.name: Math AI

Fully GDPR-compliant and currently tailored for Spanish-speaking therapists. Start today with a 7-day free trial!

records.description: StatusDeck turns Jira delivery data into management-ready Sprint, Project and Program reporting. Track delivery health, scope movement, risks, defects, workload, forecast confidence and management commentary — with PowerPoint, PDF and Confluence publishing.

records.name: N.O.V.A.
records.tagline: An AI interviewer that teaches you when you get stuck
records.description: N.O.V.A. is an AI-powered interview preparation platform for students, freshers and technical job seekers. Practice adaptive technical interviews, get detailed feedback, find your knowledge gaps and follow personalized study plans. Its "I don't know" mode turns missed answers into guided lessons, so you understand concepts instead of memorizing solutions.

records.name: OneCloud
records.tagline: Multicloud FinOps with a free forever Starter plan
records.description: OneCloud normalizes cloud bills with FOCUS and brings cost exploration, forecasts, anomaly detection, alerts and reporting into one workspace. Starter is free forever for up to 3 cloud accounts and 5 team members, with 6-month data retention. No credit card required. Enterprise deployments have custom pricing.

records.name: TF Diagrams
records.tagline: Turn your Terraform code into cloud diagrams in seconds!
records.description: Free Terraform visualizer that turnstf files into interactive AWS, Google Cloud and Azure architecture diagrams and dependency graphs, entirely in the browser.

records.name: Intexting
records.tagline: Your Language. Professional Documents.
records.description: Speak in Hindi, Marathi, or any Indian language. Get formal legal drafts, meeting minutes, sales visit reports, and interview evaluations in professional English.

records.name: Fresh Out the Attic
records.tagline: Buy, sell and give everyday items a second life
records.description: Give good things a second life. Fresh Out the Attic combines a secondhand marketplace with a Donation Center for free boxes of clothes, kitchenware, appliances and mixed household items. Buy or sell everyday finds, or label a donation box by category without photographing every item. Donors and recipients arrange pickup or shipping directly. We’re welcoming our first members—bring your items, try the site and help shape the community.

records.name: Weaver
records.tagline: Learn money by living it
records.description: Weaver is a finance education app that combines a life simulator game with practical planning tools.

records.name: Slapwars
records.tagline: A sticker wall where websites fight to be seen
records.description: Slapwars is a sticker wall for anyone with a website. Slap yours on free once a day, no account, no card. You get your own page, a shelf in the directory and a link to your site. Anyone can slap over you. Every Sunday the wall is scraped and you launch again.

records.name: Huddle
records.tagline: Tab groups manager with easy adding, searching, and more
records.description: Easily manage tab groups with features such as - - add all tabs in window to group - group by site (domain) - searching and grouping by content/title/URL - remove duplicate tabs - suspend inactive tabs - quick ungrouping

records.name: LiteManage
records.tagline: Simple CRM for customers, leads & daily operations
records.description: LiteManage is a lightweight CRM built for freelancers and small service businesses. Manage customers, leads, sales pipelines, appointments, reminders, quotations, invoices, and expenses in one simple workspace. No complicated setup or unnecessary features. Works on desktop and mobile, with all features included across plans. Start with a 14-day free trial, then plans from $8/month.

records.name: SCPN Quantum Control
records.tagline: Evidence-governed workloads on Superconducting Computers,
records.description: Evidence-governed quantum simulation of coupled-oscillator synchronisation — Kuramoto–XY workloads on Superconducting Computers, raw counts + hash-bound result packs, preregistered protocols. - anulum/scpn-quantum-control

records.name: Wexley Pro: Publishing Studio
records.tagline: Your complete book studio, built for iPhone.
records.description: Write, edit, format, and publish books from your iPhone. Wexley Pro brings manuscript management, story development, professional book design, metadata, and publishing exports into one integrated studio for authors and independent publishers.

records.name: Win a $150 Gift Card: Free $250 Giveaway
records.tagline: Win a $150 Gift Card: Free $250 Giveaway (Ends Nov 11)
records.description: Two readers will win gift cards worth $150 and $100. Enter free in about a minute. No purchase needed. Winners announced November 13, 2026.

records.name: DocZap
records.tagline: Free PDF Tools That Keep Your Files on Your Device
records.description: Merge, split, compress, convert, and edit PDFs with DocZap. Use free browser-based document tools without creating an account. Supported tools process files locally on your device.

records.name: Mini Text Generator
records.tagline: Make tiny Unicode text you can copy and paste anywhere
records.description: Mini Text Generator turns your words into small caps, superscript, and subscript text instantly. Copy a style for social bios, usernames, chats, or notes. Explore more text styles, effects, and symbols across the site. Free to use in your browser.

records.name: 3 pages daily
records.tagline: A private journal app for clarity and an organized life
records.description: A private daily journal app. Write morning pages, capture tasks, record voice notes and find it again — three pages at a time.

records.name: Alinvest
records.tagline: A clean, private portfolio tracker for ETFs and funds
records.description: Alinvest is a fast, manual portfolio tracker built for people who got tired of messy, fragile spreadsheets. Keep track of your ETFs, shares, purchase prices, and monthly DCA with total privacy—no bank connections required

records.name: CineHD APP
records.tagline: Streaming Platform for Movies and TV Shows!
records.description: Download CineHD APP for Android and watch live CineHD. Enjoy adaptive streaming, subtitles and entertainment across Android, iOS, PC & TV

records.name: Same Method
records.tagline: Help with homework the way it's taught now.
records.description: Number bonds, sound boxes, RACES, Cornell notes. If your child's homework looks nothing like yours did, each guide explains the method in about a minute, tells you what to say, and gives you a free practice sheet.

records.name: Naukricart
records.tagline: Trusted Hai Tabhi Toh Listed Hai
records.description: Naukricart is a verified job portal connecting jobseekers with employers across India through scam-free, verified listings.

records.name: QR-Code-Creator
records.tagline: Design QR codes and test that they scan before you print
records.description: Free QR code generator that runs in your browser, with custom shapes, logos, background images and a built-in scan test.

records.name: admin
records.tagline: It's Line
records.description: Muhammad Afzal is the founder of TarotWeekly.com, a space dedicated to spirituality, meditation, and astrology. Through his writing, he helps readers find clarity, reflect inward, and move forward on their self-discovery journeys.

records.name: Booky AI
records.tagline: Booky AI: Your AI Agent for Calls, Chats, and Bookings
records.description: Booky AI is your 24/7 AI receptionist. It answers calls, books jobs, sends reminders, and handles payments automatically for service businesses.

records.name: corporary
records.tagline: French company data from public registries, API and MCP
records.description: Company profiles for France built only from official registers: Sirene, the INPI business register, BODACC legal notices, financial ratios and labels. Bilingual site, REST API with a free plan, and an MCP server so AI agents can query it.

records.name: Lawn Service IQ
records.tagline: Dispatch, crew app & billing for lawn care teams
records.description: Routes, crews, billing, chemicals, and customer communication — one system for lawn care and snow removal companies.

records.name: WheelAI
records.tagline: Change your car's color, wraps and mods with AI
records.description: Hi Product Hunt! WheelAI lets you upload a photo of your car or bike and try new paint colors, wraps and racing graphics, or preview modifications - all in the browser. Standard quality is free. What should we add next: rims, tint or body kits?

records.name: Find Near Me
records.tagline: Find nearby places with maps, voice search & 9 languages
records.description: Find cafés, restaurants, hospitals and other places nearby. Explore results on an interactive map, use voice search, get directions, and switch among nine languages.

records.name: NIAKX LaunchKit
records.tagline: Launch your digital product with a founder-ready toolkit.
records.description: NIAKX LaunchKit is a practical toolkit for founders preparing to launch digital products. It brings together resources for branding, landing pages, and documentation to help turn an idea into a clear, launch-ready presentation. Built for makers who want a more organized starting point.

records.name: huandewo
records.tagline: Create your AI app for free
records.description: Quickly build AI agent apps for individuals or businesses for free using natural language.

records.name: ResumeTabs
records.tagline: Close Chrome. Come back to the exact same spot.
records.description: Chrome reopens your tabs but drops you at the top of every page and the start of every video. ResumeTabs puts you back where you actually were, even after a crash. Free, no sign-up, and nothing leaves your computer.

records.name: Chunkie
records.tagline: RAG Education and Optimization
records.description: An in-browser visualizer showing how Retrieval-Augmented Generation works: from document parsing and chunking to vector embeddings and live semantic similarity search. Test chunking strategies before you implement,

records.name: TopyCards
records.tagline: Gift Cards and more
records.description: Gift Cards and more

records.name: per.hr
records.tagline: Team hours, timesheets, reports and invoices in one place.
records.description: Time tracking, invoices and online payments for freelancers and small teams, with weekly timesheets, reports and roles for teams.

records.name: How to Win Our $250 Gift Card Giveaway
records.tagline: How to Win Our $250 Gift Card Giveaway (Easy Steps)
records.description: Enter in three simple steps: fill in the form, share the page and leave a comment for bonus entries. Free, with no purchase needed.

records.name: Color Extraktor im Browser
records.tagline: Extrahiere Farbpaletten aus jedem Bild
records.description: Ein kostenloses, datenschutzfreundliches Tool, das vollständig in deinem Browser läuft. Keine Uploads, kein Tracking - nur reine Farbextraktion.

records.name: Wild West Graphics Co.
records.tagline: Graphic Design Subscription Service
records.description: Design for when you need it the most. Personalised Commercial Graphics Subscription.

records.name: Blare
records.tagline: Free real-time multiplayer word race, no signup
records.description: Blare is a free real-time multiplayer word race for 2–5 players. Everyone gets one letter and five categories, and you race to write the rarest answers in about ten minutes. Share a room code and play in the browser — no downloads, no accounts.

records.name: Clean messy CSV files in minutes...
records.tagline: Clean Your CSV. Simplify Your Data. Save Your Time.
records.description: Clean, fix, and convert CSV files faster with a simple, powerful tool. Save time, organize messy data, and simplify your workflow! 🚀

records.name: Dieline Studio
records.tagline: Type a size, get a print-ready dieline
records.description: Free dieline generator for bags, pouches and boxes: type your sizes, get a print-ready vector PDF.

records.name: visitemap
records.tagline: Discover the perfect SEO tool for your needs
records.description: Find the right SEO tool. Browse SEO tools by category, see what is new, and compare pricing, free plans and free trials.

records.name: Sentlogic
records.tagline: SentLogic helps Shopify brands automate Instagram DMs
records.description: Instagram DM and comment automation for Shopify brands. SentLogic’s AI sales agent answers buyers, recommends products and turns conversations into orders.

records.name: BasetoMarket
records.tagline: Discover what's next. Showcase what you build.
records.description: BasetoMarket is a platform built for founders, indie hackers, and creators to showcase their products, launch new ideas, and reach their target audience. Discover innovative startups, explore useful tools, and find emerging products across different categories, all in one place.

records.name: Spend It Your Way: Win a $300 or $200
records.tagline: Spend It Your Way: Win a $300 or $200 Gift Card
records.description: Shop, eat, game or gift. Our winners choose how to spend their gift cards. Enter free in a minute, no purchase necessary.

records.name: AnimeScale
records.tagline: Vote, rank & debate your favorite anime characters ✅
records.description: AnimeScale is a community-driven platform where anime fans settle debates with votes, rankings, and discussions. Compare characters, participate in matchups, leave comments, track live results, and discover who the community thinks comes out on top. Whether it's Goku vs Vegeta, Johan vs Light, or any other matchup, AnimeScale turns anime debates into an interactive experience.

records.name: seoskills.sh
records.tagline: SEO skills for AI agents, each with a security scan
records.description: A free directory of 403 SEO skills for AI agents, in 14 categories. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Cline, Amp, OpenCode, Zed and Roo Code. Every page shows the install command, a static security scan result, and a label if the skill pre-approves shell commands or web fetching. 79 skills are ours and MIT licensed; the rest keep their authors' credit. No account needed.
